{{Youmay|the Pius Dea splinter faction|the [[Legions of Lettow]], also called the Renunciates}}
The '''Renunciates''' was a splinter faction of the [[Pius Dea]] order, which had dominated the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] for centuries at the time of the faction's creation.

==History==
Their beliefs were modified by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Caamasi/Legends|Caamasi]] influence in a concentrated effort to cause a schism in the powerful religious order, sparking a civil war within the Pius Dea. The Renunciates waged war upon the main faction, causing the Pius Dea [[Pius Dea|Faithful]] to devote more resources away from their other enemies in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The Renunciation and subsequent civil war began the [[Seventh Alsakan Conflict]], in which [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]] joined forces with the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]], the Caamasi, and several other groups against the Pius Dea-controlled Republic. After a sabotage operation by the [[Bureau of Ships and Services/Legends|Bureau of Ships and Services]], many Pius Dea [[Cathedral ship]]s were lost in space, unable to restart their [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrives]].

The remaining space forces were decimated by the Renunciates [[Battleship/Legends|battleships]]. The head of the order, [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Contispex XIX]], was [[Battle of Uquine|captured]] by a team of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] aboard [[Flame of Sinthara|his flagship]], ending both the civil war between the factions and the larger Crusades the order had inflicted upon the galaxy.
